item.title: Five Opposition Parties In Assam Files Complaint Against BJP Over Voter Roll Deletion
item.description: GUWAHATI: Five Opposition parties in Assam—the Congress, Raijor Dal, CPI(M), CPI(ML), and Assam Jatiya Parishad—have filed a police complaint accusing the BJP of attempting to manipulate electoral rolls ahead of the upcoming Assembly elections. item.title: 14 Dead as Bus Plunges into Deep Gorge in Himachal’s Sirmaur
item.description: GUWAHATI: At least 14 people lost their lives and several others were injured after a private bus plunged nearly 500 feet into a gorge in Himachal Pradesh’s Sirmaur district on January 9, Friday. The accident occurred near Haripurdhar village, around 95 km from Nahan, when the bus lost control on a narrow mountain road. item.title: Lovlina Borgohain Cruises Ahead as Assam Boxers Bag Three Medals
item.description: GUWAHATI: Olympic medallist Lovlina Borgohain advanced in the Elite Men and Women National Boxing Championships with easy wins at Gautam Buddha University, Greater Noida, with a dominant 5–0 win over Imroz Khan of Uttar Pradesh, while Assam’s Ankushita Boro and Gitimoni Gogoi secured bronze medals after bowing out in the semi-finals on Friday, January 9. item.title: Indian Idol 3 Winner & Paatal Lok Actor Prashant Tamang Passes Away
item.description: GUWAHATI: Singer and actor Prashant Tamang (43), winner of Indian Idol Season 3, passed away on Sunday, January 11, at his residence in New Delhi. Filmmaker Rajesh Ghatani confirmed the news, while singer Mahesh Sewa said Tamang reportedly suffered a cardiac arrest. He had been living in Delhi at the time of his death. item.title: Adolescence Star Owen Cooper Becomes Youngest Golden Globe Winner in Supporting Actor
item.description: GUWAHATI: “Adolescence” breakout star Owen Cooper won his first Golden Globe on Sunday, taking home the award for best male actor in a supporting role on television. At just 16, Cooper became the youngest-ever winner in this category, surpassing Chris Colfer, who was 20 when he won for Glee in 2010. item.title: Virat Kohli Breaks Tendulkar's Record, Becomes Fastest to 28,000 International Runs

item.title: Newly Discovered Frog Species Named After Late Mayali Journalist As a Tribute
item.description: GUWAHATI: Two new frog species have been identified in Arunachal Pradesh, and one of them has been named as a heartfelt tribute to a veteran Malayali journalist. The discoveries were announced in the international journal PeerJ, following extensive fieldwork and genetic analysis in the Eastern Himalayas.
